caption: 01 · REQUIRE — What is legally required now?. Identify product scope, applicable delegated acts, actor, territory, date, required fields, carrier, access rules, and official legal source. Mark future implementation unresolved until adopted.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping what is legally required now? within The Product Passport Becomes the House Record.
rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
caption: 02 · VERIFY — Who supports each field?. Bind claim, data source, responsible party, verification method, date, confidence, correction, and evidence file. Do not transform a supplier assertion into an audited fact.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping who supports each field? within The Product Passport Becomes the House Record.
rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
caption: 03 · EXTEND — What history may responsibly be added?. Connect design development, maker and repair records, care, alterations, provenance, archive deposit, rights, and permitted owner narration while minimizing personal data.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping what history may responsibly be added? within The Product Passport Becomes the House Record.
rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
caption: 04 · PRESERVE — Will the record survive the vendor?. Require export, open formats, persistent identifiers, versioning, backups, access governance, migration tests, and a non-digital fallback for essential care information.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping will the record survive the vendor? within The Product Passport Becomes the House Record.

caption: More product data does not automatically create accountability. A passport can amplify unverified claims, expose workers or consumers, shift burdens onto suppliers, and become inaccessible after sale. Evidence quality and governance matter more than interface polish.
